subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should the remaining ordinary same-session visible-message fix be refreshed through PR 89238’s admission-layer approach, limited to explicit control commands, or split by channel?
rationale: The remaining fix is a real bug, but it crosses message ordering, session-state ownership, route/thread safety, and fallback semantics that need maintainer intent before an automated repair should proceed.

options.title: Refresh PR 89238
options.body: Rebase or replace the admission-layer PR on current main, preserve PR 98126 and terminal-session recovery behavior, and fix accepted-queue fallback semantics before closing this issue.

options.title: Limit To Explicit Controls
options.body: Document that ordinary visible messages continue to queue while only `/steer`, `/tell`, `/queue`, and other control lanes can bypass busy admission for now.

options.title: Split By Channel
options.body: Track separate channel-specific follow-ups if Telegram, Discord, WebChat, and iMessage require different safe ingress boundaries before active-run queue policy.

recommendation.title: Refresh PR 89238
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the admission-layer PR on current main, preserve PR 98126 and terminal-session recovery behavior, and fix accepted-queue fallback semantics before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active non-streaming steering replacement and merged the adjacent terminal-session recovery work that the remaining admission-layer decision must preserve.
